standard: Captured surviving sources reconciled with good-enough documentary proof; exhaustive worldwide history is not certified.
submissionDatePolicy: Use source posting dates as submission dates unless other evidence establishes another date. Videos keep separate publication and observed sharing clocks. Late submissions keep actual posting dates.
remainingLimitations: Carried Snow movie retains uploader-reported 1:08.42 without independently verified video result.
Matching hashes retain earlier image and lap/result movie assessments. No fresh uninterrupted race certification.
Single-lap movie and new discussion image do not establish completed race totals.
Best-split projections and previous personal best fields do not receive new WR or profile credit.
Two source identities retain existing associations without claimed account merge.
Two late Peach/Bowser images are preserved outside the current Holiday publication scope.
Bounded surviving source review does not establish exhaustive worldwide history.
